body.text: Which exit door (Gate 9, 13, 14) do private transfers meet passengers at IST?

At Istanbul Airport (IST), most licensed private transfer operators meet international arrivals outside Exit Gate 14 (to the right after clearing customs), where greeters hold nameboards or numeric meeting codes before walking you to the vehicle bay. Official taxi ranks and M11 metro walkways are reached through Gates 9 and 13, per the [iGA Arrival Passenger Guide](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/arrival-passenger-guide?locale=en).

Airport regulations prohibit unauthorized greeters from crowding inside the customs exit doors, so do not panic if you do not see your driver immediately after baggage reclaim. Walk straight through the welcome hall to the exact exit gate number listed on your transfer voucher—Gate 14 for most international pickups, or Gate 9 if arriving on a domestic flight from Pier G.
How long does passport control take at peak morning and evening waves?

Passport control at IST typically takes 20 to 35 minutes during off-peak hours, but rises to 45 to 70 minutes during major arrival waves between 05:00–08:30, 14:00–17:30, and 22:00–01:00 when widebody flights from Europe, North America, and the Middle East land simultaneously. Add 15 to 20 minutes of walking from distant gates on Piers A, B, or F before reaching immigration.

Passengers aged 65 and over qualify for complimentary Fast Track transit points at passport control according to the [iGA Arrival Passenger Guide](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/arrival-passenger-guide?locale=en). Other travellers facing tight business schedules or post-flight fatigue—including guests visiting Türkiye for clinical care via our [medical tourism advisory](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism)—can pre-purchase [iGA Pass Fast Track](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-fast-track-p-4000) or full Meet & Greet escort service.
Which lounges (IGA, Turkish Airlines) accept Priority Pass or paid entry?

Only the iGA Lounge (both International and Domestic terminals) and the iGA Pop Up Lounge accept [Priority Pass](https://www.prioritypass.com/en-GB/lounges/turkey/istanbul), DragonPass, and paid day-pass entry at IST. By contrast, the Turkish Airlines Business Lounge and Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles Lounge in International Departures do not sell walk-in access or accept Priority Pass—entry is restricted to eligible Business Class passengers and Star Alliance Gold members.

body.text: Check the [iGA Departing Passenger Lounge directory](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/departing-passenger-guide/services/special-passenger-services/lounge?locale=en) for current hours and contracted card programmes before travelling.
Where are official Wi-Fi kiosks, SIM desks and pharmacies?

Free unlimited Wi-Fi is available throughout IST via the iGA WiFi network: log in by receiving an SMS code on your phone or by scanning your passport at the free iGA Wi-Fi kiosks stationed near baggage claim, transfer desks, and departure concourses. Official Turkcell, Vodafone, and Türk Telekom kiosks line the arrivals welcome hall immediately after customs, while 24-hour pharmacies operate on the departures level (both landside near check-in and airside).
Keep this arrival-and-departure essentials checklist handy on your phone:

items: Wi-Fi access: Use the passport-scan kiosks documented in the [iGA Arrival Passenger Guide](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/arrival-passenger-guide?locale=en) if your roaming SMS does not arrive immediately.
SIM cards vs. eSIM: Airport telecom counters are open 24/7 for convenience, but tourist packages cost significantly more than pre-installed travel eSIMs or city-centre store plans.
Pharmacies: Istanbul Airport Pharmacy operates 24 hours on the Departures floor; bring original prescriptions for controlled medicines.
Terminal maps & support: Use the [iGA interactive airport map](https://www.istairport.com/en/airport/maps/airport-map?locale=en) or call +90 444 1 442 (also on WhatsApp) for live terminal directions.

Metro & bus connections: Exit Gates 9 or 13 and follow red signs for the [M11 metro to Gayrettepe](https://www.istairport.com/en/airport/airport-transportation/urban-transportation/public-transportation?locale=en), or take elevators down to Floor -2 for [Havaist coaches](https://www.hava.ist/sefer-saatleri.php?lang=en).

faq.q: How long is the walk from IST arrivals to the M11 metro station?
faq.a: From Exit Gates 9 or 13, follow the red metro signs along the covered walkway and escalators; the walk takes approximately 8 to 12 minutes at a normal pace with luggage.

faq.q: Is free Wi-Fi at Istanbul Airport really unlimited in 2026?
faq.a: Yes. According to the official iGA Arrival Passenger Guide, Istanbul Airport provides unlimited complimentary internet via mobile SMS login or passport-scanning Wi-Fi kiosks.

faq.q: Can I buy iGA Pass Fast Track after I land at IST?
faq.a: Yes, you can purchase iGA Pass Fast Track online in advance or at iGA Pass desks near passport control, though pre-booking avoids queuing at the sales desk during peak arrival banks.

faq.q: Are there drinking water fountains inside Istanbul Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Complimentary water dispensers are positioned near restroom clusters across both international and domestic concourses, allowing you to refill bottles after security.

faq.q: Where do I find luggage storage at Istanbul Airport?
faq.a: Left-luggage lockers and staffed baggage storage offices operate 24 hours on the arrivals floor near the welcome area, useful if you have a daytime Istanbul layover.

faq.q: How early should I arrive at IST for an international departure?
faq.a: Arrive at least 3 hours before international flights—and 3.5 hours during summer peak months or for US-bound flights with secondary gate screening.
